products.name: Smark Dry Erase Paint Clear 200 Sq Ft
products.researchStatus: Exact manufacturer two-component SDS set and TDS found
products.researchNotes: The row identifies Simiron Smark Clear Dry Erase Paint in the 200 square foot kit. Simiron's current product data sheet explicitly lists the 200 sq. ft. clear semi-gloss kit as item 40002930. Because Smark is a two-component coating, the complete safety set consists of the manufacturer's separate Fill Me base SDS and Pour Me activator SDS.
